# cloudsmith_namespace (Data Source)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `slug` (String) The slug identifies the namespace in URIs.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `name` (String) A descriptive name for the namespace.
- `slug_perm` (String) The slug_perm immutably identifies the namespace. It will never change once a namespace has been created.
- `type_name` (String) Is this a user or an organization namespace?
